rows.note: Use this colloquial noun for a sudden loud bang or blast.

example.english: There was a sudden bang next door just now, and it scared me.
example.traditional: 頭先隔離突然爆咗一聲，嚇親我。
example.jyutping: tau4 sin1 gaak3 lei4 dat6 jin4 baau3 zo2 jat1 seng1 haa5 can1 ngo5

rows.note: Use this specifically when the bang is an explosion.

example.english: That explosion was such a loud bang that the whole building shook.
example.traditional: 嗰聲爆炸咁大聲，成棟樓都震晒。
example.jyutping: go2 seng1 baau3 zaa3 gam3 daai6 seng1 seng4 dung6 lau4 dou1 zan3 saai3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for hitting something hard.

example.english: I bang the table hard when I get angry.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 nau1 zau6 daai6 lik6 daa2 zoeng1 toi2

rows.note: Use this for repeated loud bangs or explosions, rather than for a forceful hit on an object.

example.english: The fireworks outside go bang bang all night without stopping.
example.traditional: 門外啲煙花嘭嘭聲咁響，成晚都未停過。
example.jyutping: mun4 ngoi6 di1 jin1 faa1 paang1 paang1 seng1 gam2 hoeng2 seng4 maan5 dou1 mei6 ting4 gwo3

rows.note: Use this when a single impact makes a bang while someone performs an action, especially shutting a door.

example.jyutping: keoi5 paang1 jat1 seng1 saan1 maai4 dou6 mun4
